citylife.jarvis.help.1: • Mark 5: use the "Suitcase" ability on the ability bar (V) — the suit unfolds from the case.
citylife.jarvis.help.2: • Flight: double-tap jump. Sprint in the air is faster, Shift goes down.
citylife.jarvis.help.3: • V, B, N, ".", "," — abilities in bar order: repulsor, unibeam, rockets, shield… X — next page.

citylife.jarvis.app.how: Suits are for the STARK TOWER owner (sold by the real estate agency for 10 000 000, filter "STARK") or cleared staff (security console in the tower workshop, 250 000).
citylife.jarvis.keys.2: Tap a mark — the suit flies in and suits you up with an arc reactor and every skill unlocked.
citylife.jarvis.keys.3: Without a reactor the armour is dead weight and you cannot move. J.A.R.V.I.S. and the Hall of Armor cases fit one for you.
citylife.jarvis.keys.4: Flight: double-tap jump. Sprint is faster, Shift goes down.
citylife.jarvis.keys.5: Abilities follow the bar at the bottom: V, B, N, ".", "," (repulsor, unibeam, rockets…). X — next page.
citylife.jarvis.keys.6: Hall of Armor: right-click a case with an empty hand to suit up, right-click an empty case in a suit to put it back. All keys — F10.
